scan_metadata.paper: Bai Y, Zhong H, Wang T, Lu ZJ. OligoFormer: an accurate and robust prediction method for siRNA design (bioRxiv 2024.02)
scan_metadata.explanation: Five tools selected from the documented CLI `python scripts/main.py ...` (run with cwd = repo/OligoFormer), all owned by module cli_wrapper. screen_sirna_offtarget is conditional on the environment manager providing perl Statistics::Lite/Bio::TreeIO, ViennaRNA and a built off-target/pita. Evaluation (-t/-s) and training are deferred with blockers recorded in reports/tutorial-scanner.json; --infer 2, RNA-FM embedding extraction, dataset preparation scripts and the comparison-method notebooks are internal or out of scope.

tutorials.title: Usage 3.1 Model inference without off-target - Option 1 (traverse mRNA)
tutorials.description: Traverses every 19-nt window of an mRNA FASTA, predicts siRNA efficacy and writes the raw, ranked and ranked+filtered tables.
tutorials.reason_for_include_or_exclude: Primary documented operation and reference evidence for the two efficacy tools.

suggested_tools.source_section: README '#### 3.1 Inference without off-target / Option 1' -> scripts/main.py argparse -> scripts/infer.py:infer (Args.infer == 1, no -i2)
suggested_tools.description: Scan a target mRNA FASTA with a 19-nt window and predict the efficacy of every siRNA candidate, with the functionality-criteria filter and an optional seed-based toxicity filter.
suggested_tools.primary_input: mRNA FASTA file (-i1); each record >= 19 nt. Optional: disable the functionality filter (-nf), enable the toxicity filter (-tox) with --toxicity_threshold (default 50.0), --seed (default 42), --output_dir (must end in '/').
suggested_tools.outputs: Per FASTA record, three tab-separated tables in --output_dir: <name>.txt (pos, sense, siRNA, efficacy, func_filter, [Seed, cell_viability, toxicity_filter], filter), <name>_ranked.txt (sorted by efficacy, descending) and <name>_ranked_filtered.txt (filter == 0 only). Side artifacts under repo/OligoFormer/data/infer/<name>/.

tutorials.title: Usage 3.1 Option 2 (predict only user-specified siRNAs)
tutorials.description: Scores only the siRNAs given in a second FASTA against the target mRNA, locating each site by reverse-complement search.
tutorials.reason_for_include_or_exclude: Distinct documented input contract; reference evidence for predict_specific_sirna_efficacy.

suggested_tools.description: Predict the efficacy of a user-supplied set of 19-nt siRNAs against a target mRNA, scoring only the siRNAs whose antisense sequence is found in that mRNA.
suggested_tools.primary_input: mRNA FASTA (-i1) plus siRNA FASTA (-i2) in which every sequence is exactly 19 nt. Same optional filter/threshold/seed/output parameters as predict_sirna_efficacy_from_mrna.
suggested_tools.outputs: The same three tab-separated tables per mRNA record, restricted to the matched siRNAs, plus a report of requested vs matched siRNAs.

tutorials.title: Usage 3.2 Inference with off-target (PITA + TargetScan) and toxicity
tutorials.description: Documented off-target pipeline merging PITA and TargetScan scores into the efficacy table; the -top N variant (assignment infer_offtarget_top_n) exercises the same tool's top_n branch.
tutorials.reason_for_include_or_exclude: Reference evidence for screen_sirna_offtarget; conditional on the off-target perl/ViennaRNA/PITA dependencies.

suggested_tools.source_section: README '#### 3.2 Inference with off-target / - Command' -> scripts/infer.py:infer (`if Args.off_target:` blocks) -> scripts/pita.sh (off-target/pita/pita_prediction.pl) and scripts/targetscan.sh (off-target/targetscan/targetscan_70*.pl)
suggested_tools.description: Predict siRNA efficacy for a target mRNA and additionally screen the candidates for off-target potential with PITA and TargetScan over reference human UTR/ORF sequences, optionally combined with the toxicity filter and restricted to the top N candidates by efficacy. CONDITIONAL: only exposed if the environment provides perl Statistics::Lite/Bio::TreeIO, ViennaRNA and a built off-target/pita.
suggested_tools.primary_input: mRNA FASTA (-i1) with -off; optional -tox, -top N (N <= number of siRNA candidates), --utr/--orf reference files (defaults off-target/ref/100_human_UTR.txt and 100_human_ORF.txt), --pita_threshold (default -10), --targetscan_threshold (default 1), --toxicity_threshold.
suggested_tools.outputs: The three result tables extended with pita_score, targetscan_score, off_target_filter (and the toxicity columns when -tox), plus data/infer/<name>/pita.tab and data/infer/<name>/targetscan.tab.
suggested_tools.conditional_on: environment manager confirming perl modules, ViennaRNA and the off-target/pita build; otherwise excluded with that blocker

tutorials.title: Docker usage example `oligoformer -m 2` (traverse 1- and 2-mismatch variants)
tutorials.description: Enumerates and scores all 1-/2-mismatch (optionally 3-mismatch) variants of a 19-nt RNA with the mismatch CNN.
tutorials.reason_for_include_or_exclude: Only documented invocation of the mismatch traversal mode; reference evidence for scan_sirna_mismatch_variants.

suggested_tools.source_section: README '## User-friendly Docker image' (`oligoformer -m 2`) -> scripts/main.py -m 2|3 -> scripts/mismatch.py:mismatch (else branch) / generate_mismatch_sequences / calculate_kon
suggested_tools.description: Enumerate every 1- and 2-mismatch variant of a 19-nt siRNA (optionally also 3-mismatch) and score each variant's relative on-rate (kon) against the base sequence.
suggested_tools.primary_input: One 19-nt A/U/C/G RNA sequence (passed on the child's stdin, since mismatch.py uses input()) and mismatch_depth 2 or 3 (-m).
suggested_tools.outputs: Tab-separated table <output_dir>/result/mismatch.txt with columns seq, kon, num_mismatch (1539 rows for depth 2; about 27.7k rows for depth 3).

tutorials.title: mismatch() branch Args.mismatch == 1 (compare two RNAs)
tutorials.description: Scores the relative on-rate (kon) of one mismatched 19-nt RNA against a 19-nt base RNA; documented by the scripts/main.py argparse help for -m.
tutorials.reason_for_include_or_exclude: The -m 1 branch is only documented in the CLI help, so the source symbol is the binding; reference evidence for compare_sirna_mismatch_kon.

suggested_tools.description: Score the relative on-rate (kon) of a specific mismatched 19-nt RNA against a 19-nt base RNA using the pretrained mismatch CNN.
suggested_tools.primary_input: Two 19-nt A/U/C/G RNA sequences (base and mismatched), supplied on the child's stdin in that order.
suggested_tools.outputs: A single kon score parsed from stdout; no files are written.
